findings.summary: The release status names the blocker only by its internal id P-7f3a2; the lead skill and the lead-tools allow-list offer no command that says what that process is, and the database read was refused by policy.

gaps.what: What process P-7f3a2 is, who started it and whether it may be stopped.
gaps.proposal: Extend the release status report so that it names the process behind each internal id: its kind, who started it, its progress and whether it can be stopped safely.

next.reason: The product has no sanctioned report that explains a blocking process.

reply: Release 2.5.0 waits for process P-7f3a2, which is still running. The release report will be extended so that it says what such a process is and who runs it; we will write to you as soon as the release can go on.
leadLine: 2.5.0 blocked by P-7f3a2; no sanctioned way to learn what it is; fix the release status report.

fixBrief.goal: The release status report names the process behind each internal id that blocks a release: kind, starter, progress and whether it can be stopped safely.
